name: Simple Diamond
source:
Most people don't realize how badly a run in with a stranger can go until something happens to them.

[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/simple-diamond]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大多数人在祸事真正落到自己头上之前，从来意识不到与陌生人的一次偶遇究竟会酿成多么可怕的后果。

[摘自[url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/simple-diamond]Itch.io[/url]]
